latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the Jira PAT Skill.

- Enables Jira issue management on self-hosted/enterprise Jira instances using Personal Access Tokens (PAT).
- Supports SSO/SAML environments where Basic Auth and `jira-cli` do not work.
- Provides guidance and shell/curl/jq recipes for getting issue details, searching with JQL, transitioning issues, commenting, updating, and creating issues.
- Includes troubleshooting tips for common API errors.
- Details environment variable setup and compares with Basic Auth-based skills.
